shots.content: Inside a living room, a sofa and armchairs surround a low coffee table between a bookcase and the doorway. A woman in a red shirt sits in the bookcase-side sofa seat and announces the dinner plans for the visit, while a man in an orange shirt sits in the bookcase-side armchair.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway side, looking across the coffee table toward the bookcase, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a green shirt enters and sits in the doorway-side sofa seat. She answers that the invitations were delivered when a woman in a red shirt asks if the dinner invitations were sent.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the coffee-table side, centered on the two adjacent sofa seats.

shots.content: A woman in a red shirt confirms that the meal will be served shortly.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the bookcase side, looking across the coffee table toward the doorway, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair in frame.
